proof.text: Restrict the augmented Cartan–Eilenberg bicomplex to complex degrees s ≥ q and extend by zero. The rows resolve the stupid truncation; finite diagonals give a bounded-below K-injective total and its augmentation computes derived global sections.
Use the mapped-total diagonal formula to identify the restricted mapped total with (T.L).step q and apply the K-injective computation to obtain the degree-p isomorphism.

Compare the restricted augmentation with the truncation inclusion via T.aug_formula and T.over_K; the K-injective comparison principle, T.w_formula and T.c_formula identify the induced map with the derived truncation map. This also handles empty diagonals and arbitrary integer bounds.

title: Compatibility of filtered-step cohomology isomorphism
statement: For X,K,T,p,q, the canonical isomorphism selected by the preceding existence theorem satisfies the truncation inclusion homology equation.

lean.statement:
theorem etale_filtered_step_cohomology_compatibility
    (X : Scheme.{u})
    (K : CochainComplex.Plus (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}))
    (T : EtaleTermwiseHypercohomology X K) (p q : ℤ) :
    HomologicalComplex.homologyMap (T.L.step q).arrow p ≫ (T.c p).hom =
      (Classical.choice (etale_filtered_step_cohomology_iso X K T p q)).hom ≫
        (cohomology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} X p).map
          (DerivedCategory.Q.map (K.obj.ιStupidTrunc (ComplexShape.embeddingUpIntGE q)))
